title: Development and Validation of an Artificial Neural Network for the Recognition of Custom Dataset with YOLOv4
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and performance validation of the YOLOv4 object detection algorithm for industrial use. Although the authors mention sustainability as a motivator and briefly refer to the ethical concerns of original YOLO developers regarding military applications and privacy, the research does not include an evaluation or benchmark of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
